decks.notes: This UR Aggro deck focuses on using low-cost spells and creatures to apply pressure quickly and efficiently to the opponent. By utilizing cards that can be played for low mana cost and deal direct damage, along with card draw and graveyard recursion, the deck seeks to overwhelm the opponent before they can establish their own game plan. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds additional versatility and consistency to the deck. Overall, the deck aims to outpace and outmaneuver the opponent through aggressive gameplay and efficient card selection.

This aggressive Rakdos deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's plays with cards like Thoughtseize and Grief, while putting pressure with evasive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Orcish Bowmasters. It also utilizes graveyard recursion with cards like Dauthi Voidwalker and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker. The deck aims to control the board with a mix of removal spells like Fatal Push and Lightning Bolt, as well as disruptive creatures like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse. Overall, the deck seeks to apply early pressure and disrupt the opponent's strategy to secure a quick victory.

The key concept of this deck is to utilize a toolbox of creatures to assemble powerful combos, with the help of cards like Agatha's Soul Cauldron, Chord of Calling, and Yawgmoth, Thran Physician. By searching for specific creatures with Chord of Calling and using Yawgmoth's abilities to manipulate the board, the deck aims to control the battlefield while setting up win conditions with cards like Grist, the Hunger Tide and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Wall of Roots and Ignoble Hierarch to accelerate mana production and cast powerful creatures quickly.

This deck aims to control the game using powerful control cards and The One Ring as the win condition. It focuses on disruption, removal, and card advantage to outvalue the opponent and eventually overwhelm them with powerful threats like Omnath, Locus of Creation. The deck also includes a companion in the form of Keruga, the Macrosage, to provide additional card draw and consistency. By managing the board state and resources efficiently, this deck seeks to take control of the game and secure victory through a strategic approach to gameplay.

This deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly to play Primeval Titan and search for utility lands like Urza's Saga, Vesuva, and Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle. The goal is to generate a high amount of mana to play multiple lands per turn with Amulet of Vigor and Primeval Titan, allowing for explosive plays and quick victories. The deck also utilizes cards like Explore, Arboreal Grazer, and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove to accelerate land drops and maintain a constant stream of mana, ultimately leading to a powerful combo finish with the Titan.

The deck focuses on using creatures with various abilities to generate value and disrupt the opponent's strategy. It utilizes Chord of Calling to search for specific creatures, such as Grist, the Hunger Tide, Yawgmoth, Thran Physician, and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse, to create a versatile toolbox of options. Agatha's Soul Cauldron and Blood Artist provide additional ways to generate value and drain the opponent's life total. The deck aims to outvalue the opponent through its creature interactions and combo potential, while also having a toolbox of creatures to adapt to different situations.

This deck focuses on aggressive plays with early game disruption and efficient creatures. The key strategy is to control the board with removal spells like Fatal Push and Lightning Bolt while applying pressure with powerful creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Grief. The deck also utilizes cards like Not Dead After All and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to maintain card advantage and push damage through. By combining disruption, aggression, and card advantage, Rakdos Aggro aims to quickly overwhelm opponents and secure victories in the early turns of the game.

The deck focuses on utilizing low-cost spells and creatures to deal quick and consistent damage to the opponent. It emphasizes card advantage through cards like Expressive Iteration and Mishra's Bauble to maintain momentum. The inclusion of Underworld Breach allows for the possibility of recurring spells from the graveyard for additional value. The presence of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides additional mana flexibility. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays and efficient use of resources.

The main concept of this Mono Black Control deck is to manipulate your opponent's resources and disrupt their game plan while building up your own board presence. Utilize cards like Fatal Push, Thoughtseize, and Demolition Field to control the battlefield, while also utilizing cards like Cabal Coffers and Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth to generate mana advantage. The inclusion of powerful creatures like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and The One Ring serve as win conditions to close out the game once you have established control.

This deck focuses on utilizing powerful control elements to disrupt the opponent's strategy while ramping up mana with Utopia Sprawl and Arbor Elf. The goal is to lock down the opponent's resources with cards like Blood Moon and Karn, the Great Creator, while also applying pressure with cards like Lightning Bolt and Bonecrusher Giant. The deck also has a strong late-game plan with cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Klothys, God of Destiny. Overall, this deck aims to control the game and grind out a victory with its powerful threats and disruption.

The deck revolves around utilizing control cards such as Force of Negation, Counterspell, and Supreme Verdict to protect and stall until The One Ring, a crucial card, can be played. Other key cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Narset, Parter of Veils help control the game while Leyline Binding and Lórien Revealed provide additional support. The deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent through a combination of removal, counterspells, and card advantage, ultimately leading to victory through the power of The One Ring.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize cards like Grief, Shardless Agent, and Living End to quickly and efficiently cycle through the deck and bring back powerful creatures from the graveyard. By using cards like Street Wraith and Architects of Will to quickly cycle through the deck, and control options like Force of Negation and Subtlety to disrupt the opponent's strategy, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a strong board presence and powerful combos. The deck also includes lands like Boseiju, Who Endures and Otawara, Soaring City to provide additional utility and support for the combo strategy.

The deck focuses on utilizing powerful control spells and card advantage engines to outvalue the opponent and maintain board control. The key strategy involves using counterspells, removal, and disruptive cards to disrupt the opponent's game plan while drawing cards and generating value with cards like Narset, Parter of Veils and The One Ring. The deck aims to control the game until it can establish a dominant position and win through attrition or by resolving a game-winning threat.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with fast and aggressive creatures while utilizing powerful spells like Tribal Flames and Lightning Bolt to control the board and deal direct damage. The inclusion of Leyline of the Guildpact and Leyline Binding also helps to disrupt opponent strategies and protect your own creatures. Jegantha, the Wellspring serves as a versatile companion option for additional value. Overall, this deck aims to establish early dominance and maintain pressure throughout the game to secure a quick victory.

The deck focuses on quickly playing out artifact creatures and utilizing artifact synergies to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy. Cards like Springleaf Drum and Thoughtcast help to draw more cards and keep the deck running smoothly, while cards like Nettlecyst and Shadowspear provide additional power and protection for the creatures. Urza's Saga is a key component of the strategy, allowing the deck to search for important artifacts and land cards to further advance the game plan. Overall, the deck aims to establish a strong board presence early on and maintain pressure throughout the game.

The deck focuses on assembling a toolbox of creatures that work together to create powerful combos and synergies. It includes cards that allow for creature tutoring and sacrifice, along with creatures that have strong abilities on their own or when paired with others. The deck aims to outvalue the opponent through efficient creature interactions and utilizing its toolbox of creatures to disrupt the opponent's game plan and create favorable board states. It thrives on generating value from sacrificing and recurring creatures while applying pressure and creating a challenging board presence.
